evidenceModel.dossierAccepted: Explicit required checkbox on a one-work consultation; stored in the durable consultation record and counted only while active.
evidenceModel.purchaseIntent: Separate explicit checkbox stating intent to consider purchase within the selected timing if budget, physical quality, and delivery terms fit.
evidenceModel.qualifiedPipeline: JPY 330,000 only when budget is 330k+, timing is within 90 days, decision authority is confirmed, Dossier is accepted, and purchase intent is explicitly confirmed.

truthBoundary: Deployment and schema are proven. No customer acceptance, purchase intent, qualified prospect, pipeline, payment or revenue is claimed until a real consented record exists.
